nodes.label: scripts/init/ Bootstrap Package
nodes.rationale: Uses google.auth AuthorizedSession REST API calls instead of wrapping gcloud, firebase-tools, or terraform binaries so it runs inside the existing cli Python environment without external CLI dependencies or mutating tracked infra/ files.

nodes.label: photosphere.config.json Unified Config
nodes.rationale: Consolidates runtime configuration across cli/, ssr/, Makefile, and docker-compose.yml into a single git-ignored JSON file validated against contracts/photosphere_config.schema.json, preventing drift across separate .env files.

nodes.label: Dual-Bucket GCS Architecture
nodes.rationale: Splits frequently updated JSON databases into a Standard-class GCS bucket (PHOTOSPHERE_DATA_BUCKET) while keeping original media and thumbnails/ in the Archive-class GCS bucket (PHOTOSPHERE_MEDIA_BUCKET) to avoid Archive retrieval fees and 365-day early-deletion charges.

nodes.label: Flat SHA-1 Keyed JSON Database
nodes.rationale: Replaces TinyDB _default wrapper and eliminates Protobuf (.pb) artifacts; SHA-1 hash is the primary key for deduplication while average_hash >= 90% reuses AI labels/captions without discarding distinct photos.

nodes.label: AIProvider Protocol
nodes.rationale: Decouples vision AI labeling/captioning behind a Protocol and optional [ai] extras so core CLI operations and tests run without multi-GB ML packages.

nodes.label: scripts/migrate_v2_to_v3.py
nodes.rationale: Isolated disposable migration script so cli/ and ssr/ carry zero legacy TinyDB backward-compatibility code after cutover.

nodes.label: Dual Authentication Boundary (__ps_media + Bearer)
nodes.rationale: JSON and mutation APIs require Authorization: Bearer Firebase ID tokens (preventing CSRF), while GET /api/media/[hash] uses an HttpOnly __ps_media session cookie so native and

nodes.label: World Map Heatmap & Spatial Inspector Design
nodes.author: alessandro-candon

nodes.label: GET /api/map/heatmap
nodes.rationale: Uses two-tier in-memory geohash aggregation (O(B) precomputed buckets when unfiltered, O(M) filtered pass) with a 5,000-point raw mode fallback instead of an embedded SQLite database to achieve <20ms latency without duplicating 100k+ records.

nodes.label: MapInspectDrawer & Click-to-Inspect
nodes.rationale: Uses Haversine distance sorting via GET /api/files?sort=distance instead of geohash prefix matching to guarantee circular coverage without cell-boundary seams.
